name: Angiogenesis in Health and Diseases
description: Angiogenesis and vasculogenesis; the lymphatic system; introduction to blood vessels: types, structure, and composition; components of blood vessels – endothelial cells, pericytes, and vascular smooth muscle cells; vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) biology – its role in angiogenesis and vascular permeability; basic fibroblast growth factor (FGF) biology; VEGF and FGF receptors, tyrosine kinase signaling and activation; the relationship between angiogenesis and the immune system; tumor angiogenesis – the Judah Folkman hypothesis, significant discoveries, and the evolution of vascular biology in cancer; tumor vasculature and perfusion; current status of anti-angiogenesis as a therapeutic strategy; the differences between blood vessel inhibition and normalization; vessel co-option and vascular mimicry; atherogenesis; anti-angiogenic therapy in age-related macular degeneration; vascular aging; various in vitro, in vivo, and ex vivo models for studying vascular biology.
